A SMALL HORROR / ACTION GAME PLATFORM

GAME 01
SOUND OF SURVIVAL

First-person survival horror maze. You cannot see what hunts you. Pulse sonar, collect the purple and blue discs, and reach the beacon. Every sound you make may be heard.

GAME 02
DEMON ARENA

Third-person pixel-art action. Play the demon girl, pick a sword, fight new monsters, Medusas and eye-bats across 5 waves, and face the Dragon. WASD, mouse, LMB / RMB / R / Q.
